described_as: 56 items generated from claims_dev_drafts.jsonl on 18 Oct 2026

rules.cutoff: The date the user types. If none, the filing date of the company's newest 10-K or 10-Q. News is not used. Last quarter is the latest quarter ending on or before the cut-off.
rules.periods: No period named means the latest fiscal year. Trailing, last 12 months, or TTM means the sum of the last four quarters.
rules.matching: A percentage matches within 0.5 percentage points. A dollar amount matches after rounding to the stated precision. Doubled means 1.9 to 2.1 times.
rules.calculations: Only revenue growth, net income growth, operating margin, net margin, free cash flow, current ratio, and debt-to-equity are calculated.
rules.segments: Segment figures are checked by the narrative agent from filing text.
rules.names: A missing name gets one question, then the request is rejected as incomplete. Two in-scope influencers are split into two claims.
rules.stops: Advice, a price only, an index or macro remark only, two companies each with their own claim, and a company outside scope are stopped. No stored post about the company is a refusal.
rules.record: A consistency or accuracy question checks every stored post, each with its own date, and has no single overall label.
